text:
maya: Quick heads-up — EdgeVault asked for a joint plan for their edge-HSM + SSO/SCIM integration before marketplace listing. Need owners for SCIM schema mapping, KMS adapter, and SI POC. Target: sign-off by 2025-08-01. @oliver @jules @kenneth

edgevault-bob: Thanks Maya — we can commit HW firmware v2.1 and the HSM SDK. We expect to need a short wrapper on your side for key import/attestation flow. Available next Tue/Wed. :wave:

oliver: I can take the KMS adapter. Need details on attestation flow. Do we have a sequence diagram? Also, do we support PKCS#11 or only gRPC HSM API?

jules: security note — we require FIPS mode + HSM-backed key import audit trail. Also SCIM must preserve externalId and employeeNumber. We'll want a short threat-model doc before POC.

kenneth: I can run the SI POC with NimbleSI. Minimal acceptance criteria I propose: SCIM provisioning (create/update/delete), SSO/SAML metadata exchange, KMS sign/unwrap test vectors, and marketplace listing checklist. Anything else?

maya: Good list. I'll sketch an RFC and a one-pager for partners. Also need comms plan for joint announcement — draft embargo 2025-09-10.

edgevault-bob: FYI our legal prefers co-announcement copy 10 days ahead. Also here is a partner brief to reference: https://edgevault.example.com/rv-integration

oliver: For attestation, propose this minimal flow to start:
```
1. EdgeVault -> TPM quote
2. Redwood verify quote via partner root cert
3. Exchange ephemeral attested key for import
```
Need partner test vectors (nonce, cert chain) and expected error cases.

maya: Can everyone ack owners so we can put into the RFC? KMS adapter = @oliver, SCIM mapping = @jules, SI POC = @kenneth, Partner liaison = @maya, Docs = @maria (cc) :white_check_mark:

maria: docs owner — got it. I'll produce an integration guide skeleton + marketplace PR template and link back here.

maya: OK scheduling: sync Wed 11am PT. I'll send invite and attach draft RFC. :calendar:
